figurative_meaning_en: The final stage of life's conditions; death
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনের শেষদশায় সে একা হয়ে গিয়েছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: His final days were extremely painful.
In the last stage of life, he was left alone.
note: This idiom reflects the philosophical view of life's transient stages in Bengali literature.
